annotations.title: Tax disputes: motions at a stage of the case

description: Statements and motions available at the current stage of an administrative tax case (renewal of the term, court fee relief, hearing with the parties, demand for evidence, video conference, reply to the defence), with norms and why some are not available yet.

has_case_number.description: The court has opened proceedings and the case number is known.

jurisdiction.description: State whose procedure applies. Only "ua" (Ukraine) for now.

stage.description: draft = not filed yet; filed = filed, waiting for the court ruling; opened = proceedings opened; hearing = hearings under way; decided = first-instance decision; appeal = appeal stage; final = decision in force.
